column1: Shipment Zero is our goal to deliver 50% of Amazon shipments with
net-zero carbon by 2030. Achieving Shipment Zero means that the
fulfillment operations we undertake to deliver customer shipments are
net-zero carbon—from the fulfillment center where an item is picked
off the shelf, to the materials used to package the item, and the mode
of transportation that gets the package to the customer’s door.
